title: Yogurt and granola bowls

items: 3 cups plain or vanilla Greek yogurt
1 cup nuts (almonds, pecans or walnuts), roughly chopped
¼ cup neutral oil or melted coconut oil

steps: Heat the oven to 325°F with a rack in the middle. Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
In a large bowl, stir the oats, nuts, cinnamon and salt. Add the maple syrup and oil and stir until every oat looks shiny and coated.
Spread it on the pan in an even layer and press it down firmly with the spatula.
Bake 12 min. Stir so the edges don't burn, press it flat again and bake 10–13 min more, until golden brown and fragrant. It will still feel a little soft.
Cool completely on the pan, at least 20 min, without touching it. It crisps and forms clusters as it cools. Break it into pieces.
For each bowl, spoon in ¾ cup yogurt and top with about ⅓ cup granola and a handful of berries or banana slices.
tips: Add the granola right before eating so it stays crunchy.
Watch the last 5 min of baking. Maple syrup goes from golden to burnt quickly.
Stir in ½ cup raisins or dried cranberries after baking, not before, or they burn.
storage: Granola keeps in an airtight jar at room temperature up to 2 weeks, or frozen up to 3 months. Build bowls just before eating, since they get soggy. Cut berries keep 2–3 days in the fridge. Slice banana fresh.
